subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw continue shortening home-directory paths in user-visible agent/tool output, switch to full absolute paths by default, or use a narrower repo-relative/current-workspace convention?
rationale: Current source and tests deliberately preserve `~/...`, the merged related PR only fixed malformed prefix clipping, and the earlier env-var approach was closed unmerged despite targeting this request.

options.title: Keep compact display policy
options.body: Preserve `~/...` for real home paths, continue fixing only corruption or ambiguity, and close or retitle this as a policy/docs clarification if maintainers agree.

options.title: Switch to absolute paths
options.body: Make full absolute paths the default across session tool renderers and shared display helpers, then update tests and prompt guidance to match that new contract.

options.title: Add an explicit opt-in
options.body: Introduce a narrowly documented setting only if maintainers accept the extra config surface despite the repository's high bar for new env/config options.

recommendation.title: Keep compact display policy
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` for real home paths, continue fixing only corruption or ambiguity, and close or retitle this as a policy/docs clarification if maintainers agree.

likelyOwner.reason: No declared code owner was found for this specific path-display surface; the merged related `shortenPath` work is the strongest available area-history signal.
